owner_key.description: The local owner key stub file (F1c B1): a protected state path, read and written by no role; the platform keystore replaces it (features.json stub).

approval_store.description: The approval service's store folder (F1c B2): requests, decisions, used nonces; a protected state path.

event_writer_state.description: The trusted event writer's state (F1c B7): its chain key, last sequence number and last mac; a protected state path.

routing_state.description: The failover state (F2 D1.7): cooldowns per link and the switches of each task; written on the host only; a protected state path. Never proof of a grant or an approval.

probe_records.description: The capability probe's records (F2b B), one file (schema probes): what bin/probe.py found out about each model version by trying it; written on the host only; a protected state path, not a data file (no role writes it, git never holds it). bin/probe.py check judges it.

usage_ledger.description: The usage ledger (F2c A1), JSON lines, append-only (schema usage): one line per model call, written by bin/ledger.py on the host only; a protected state path, not a data file (git never holds it). bin/ledger.py check judges it.

ledger_state.description: The ledger's live state (F2c A1, schema ledger-state): the limits observed on a connection or model, with their expiry; its slot lock files lie in the folder of the same name plus .slots. Written on the host only; a protected state path.

triage_calibration.description: The triage router's fitted threshold (F2b F), one file (schema triage-calibration): written by bin/triage.py fit from the labelled verdicts, on the host only; a protected state path, not a data file (no role writes it, git never holds it).

benchmark_results.description: The benchmark results (F2c E), one file (schema benchmarks): one record per trial of a task for a role on a link, each with a trusted benchmark.recorded event line; read by bin/compare.py, which ignores invalid, foreign-install and unproved records; a protected state path, not a data file (no role writes it, git never holds it).

card_facts.description: The card facts store (F2 DC-01), a folder: one <card>.json per card ({project, carries_secrets, vault_content}), written on the host only; a protected state path. A missing record or field counts as routing.json card_facts.when_missing says.

untrusted_events.description: The untrusted event stream (F1c B7): lines written from a worker environment; never proof; not protected.

event_writer_id.description: The trusted event writer's identity, carried on every chained line with the install id (F1c B7).

record_kind.description: The kind of the row's records: a key of data-policy record_kinds, which gives their sync class. A row with records (a list_key, or a folder row) must name one. x-record-kind-of pins it for the rows of a schema (the data policy's records are projects: a relabel would move the default and every project onto another kind's sync class).

global_id.description: The record's global id: a lower-case version 4 UUID, unique across every data file (product rule 14). The record's old id stays its alias: every read that takes an entry id accepts either.

install_id.description: The UUID of the install that made the record (its .stella/install.json); a record moved from another install keeps it.

agents_dir.description: The folder bin/team.py writes and checks the build team's agent files in (F2b G), one file per agent of the team preset.

team_bodies.description: The folder of the agents' body texts (F2b G), <agent>.md each: tracked prose bin/team.py copies below the generated front matter.

team_preset.description: The preset (a key of the role-assignments effort_modes) bin/team.py generates and checks when no --preset is given (F2b G).

spans.description: The call spans (F2c B), one JSON line per call with OpenTelemetry GenAI attribute names, appended by bin/cost.py span --write; written on the host only; a protected state path, not a data file. Export to an outside tool is behind the features.json flag otlp-export.

budget_state.description: The budget state (F2c C, schema budget-state): thresholds already alerted, holds with their approval request, card estimates and actuals, anomaly episodes already alerted. Written on the host only, by bin/budget.py; a protected state path, not a data file.

model_check_state.description: The weekly model check's state (F2c F; schema model-check-state): the paused flag and when each connection's model list was last read. Written on the host by bin/model_check.py only; a protected state path, not a data file; never the source of a pick or a rollback (the trusted event line is).

run_tokens.description: The run token state (F3 item T, bin/run_token.py): sha256 of each token with its run, role, card, link, connection type, expiry and revocation; never a token value. Written on the host only; a state path under the protected repo paths, not a data file.

model_proxy_state.description: The model proxy's bound address, port and pid (F3 item T, bin/model_proxy.py serve). Written on the host only; not a data file.
